author: P. N. Evans
title: Senator Katie Boyd Britt voices strong opinions on Iran policy and national security
text:
Senator Katie Boyd Britt, a member of several Senate committees and chair of the homeland security appropriations subcommittee, shared her views on international affairs and sports in a series of posts on June 10, 2026.
In a post referencing soccer, Britt wrote on June 10: “Smart move to wait 15 years. That 2011 Alabama defense wouldn’t have let the Euros cross midfield.”
Later that day, she commented on U.S. foreign policy toward Iran. On June 10 at 14:41 UTC, Britt stated, “When @POTUS sets his mind to something, he gets it done. That has never been clearer than it is today. By holding the murderous Iranian regime accountable, President Trump continues to step up and do what none of his predecessors did over the past 47 years.”
She continued her criticism of Iran in another post made minutes later: “Iran is the head of the snake. They are the largest state sponsor of terrorism in the world and have been chanting “Death to America” for nearly 50 years. They want to wipe the United States off the map, and it is despicable that Democrats would root against the President’s”
Britt supports Alabamians through various services such as coordinating with federal agencies and nominating candidates for U.S. service academies ( official website ). She advocates for family values, economic opportunities, social media safeguards for minors, mental health access policies, educational options, agricultural aid and national security initiatives. Prior to her tenure in the Senate, Britt served as president of Alabama’s business council.
Her recent statements reflect ongoing concerns about Iran’s role in international terrorism and highlight partisan divisions regarding U.S. policy toward Tehran.
